title: Executive Regulation Authority Over Exam Remuneration and Grants
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Executive Regulation Authority
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the Executive Regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية) is the authority entrusted with establishing the general framework for implementing the provisions of the law, not the University Council acting alone. FAIL if the note attributes that authority solely to the University Council or omits the role of the Executive Regulation.

criteria.title: Exam Remuneration Rules
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the rules governing secondment for examination duties and the remuneration related thereto are among the competencies entrusted to the Executive Regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية). FAIL if the note omits or misattributes responsibility for examination secondment and remuneration rules away from the Executive Regulation.

criteria.title: Financial Grants Rules
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the rules for determining financial remuneration and grants for faculty members (أعضاء هيئة التدريس) are regulated by the Executive Regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية). FAIL if the note omits or misattributes the regulation of financial remuneration and grants for faculty members away from the Executive Regulation.

criteria.title: Issuance Procedure
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the Executive Regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية) is issued by a decision of the President of the Republic based on the submission of the Minister of Higher Education and after taking the opinion of the Universities Council (مجلس الجامعات) and the approval of the Supreme Council of Universities (المجلس الأعلى للجامعات). FAIL if the note omits or alters any of these conditions, bodies, or procedural steps.

criteria.title: Decision Invalidity
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a decision issued by the University Council acting alone does not satisfy the legally prescribed procedures and is considered in violation of the law (مخالفاً للقانون). FAIL if the note does not identify the University Council's unilateral decision as legally defective or contrary to the law.

review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-005 against Article 196 of the Universities Organization Law (Law No. 49 of 1972) as in force at the time of Fatwa No. 30 (2016/12/14, prior to Law No. 152 of 2019), confirming the Executive Regulation's authority over examination remuneration and faculty grants and its prescribed issuance procedure.
